notes.title: Major Update: Share and Explore Community-Created Levels!
notes.notes:
The new Cat Lines update brings an exciting feature that players have been waiting for! Now, in addition to creating and customizing your own levels, you can share your creations with the world directly on Steam! But that’s not all – the game now includes a dedicated Community Levels section, where you can explore, download, and play amazing levels created by other players.

Key features of this update include:


 Level Sharing: Create your levels and upload them directly to Steam. Show your creativity to the world and share with your friends.
 Community Levels Section: Access and explore levels made by other players directly within the game. Discover unique challenges and play the best community creations.
 Easy Download and Play: When you find a level you like, simply click to download and start playing immediately.
 Endless Possibilities: With this new feature, the number of levels to play has increased exponentially, making each Cat Lines session even more fun and challenging.



Get ready to dive into a wealth of new challenges and creations. Join the Cat Lines community and share your love for level design!
